prompt_text: Which pest control company should I choose for my home in the Southeast US (Florida, Georgia, Texas)?
response_text:
In the Southeast (Florida, Georgia, and Texas), pest control needs are unique compared to the rest of the country due to year-round humidity and warmth. The biggest regional threats are **subterranean and Formosan termites, palmetto bugs (American cockroaches), fire ants, roof rats, and mosquitoes**.
